req.title: Reject duplicate playerId on create
req.statement: The system shall respond with HTTP 409 Conflict when POST /players/ is called with an ID that already exists.

doc.reasoning: R-PLAYER-007 requires HTTP 409 Conflict when POST /players/ is called with a squad_number that already exists. The route checks retrieve_by_squad_number_async and raises HTTPException(409) on a hit. Tests must cover: (1) positive path — a genuinely new squad number succeeds with 201; (2) negative path — a duplicate squad number returns exactly 409 with the documented detail string; (3) boundary — squad number 26 (last pre-loaded row) triggers 409, squad number 27 (first unused) succeeds with 201; (4) state-transition — create then immediately re-create the same player to confirm the transition from 'absent' to 'present' triggers 409; (5) decision-table — all required fields present vs duplicate key, confirming the conflict check fires before any DB write. Mutation resilience: exact status codes (201, 409), exact detail string, exact response body fields, both sides of the duplicate/non-duplicate branch.

tests.name: test_post_new_player_returns_201
preconditions: Database contains exactly 26 pre-loaded players with squad numbers 1-26
actions: POST /players/ with a valid payload using squad_number=27
expected: Response body contains the submitted fields
Response body contains a non-null id (UUID)
trace: R-PLAYER-007 — happy path: new squad number must succeed
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
client = TestClient(app)

def test_post_new_player_returns_201():
    payload = {
        "firstName": "Test",
        "lastName": "Player",
        "squadNumber": 27,
        "position": "Goalkeeper"
    }
    r = client.post("/players/", json=payload)
    assert r.status_code == 201
    body = r.json()
    assert body["squadNumber"] == 27
    assert body["firstName"] == "Test"
    assert body["lastName"] == "Player"
    assert body["position"] == "Goalkeeper"
    assert "id" in body
    assert body["id"] is not None

tests.name: test_post_duplicate_does_not_create_extra_record
preconditions: Database contains exactly 26 pre-loaded players with squad numbers 1-26
actions: GET /players/ again to verify count unchanged
expected: Collection size after failed POST equals collection size before
trace: R-PLAYER-007 — DT: duplicate key must not mutate the collection
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
client = TestClient(app)

def test_post_duplicate_does_not_create_extra_record():
    r_before = client.get("/players/")
    assert r_before.status_code == 200
    count_before = len(r_before.json())
    assert count_before == 26

    payload = {
        "firstName": "Duplicate",
        "lastName": "Nair",
        "squadNumber": 5,
        "position": "Central Midfield"
    }
    r_dup = client.post("/players/", json=payload)
    assert r_dup.status_code == 409
    assert r_dup.json()["detail"] == "A Player with this squad number already exists."

    r_after = client.get("/players/")
    assert r_after.status_code == 200
    count_after = len(r_after.json())
    assert count_after == count_before
